RESOLVED CARRY (M6): the doctors' own reduction rates now have values (1.081 / 1.781 / 1.081) and the skill's instrument attribution was corrected from the 31.3.2025 wage agreement to the 23.1.2025 freeze agreement.

RESOLVED CARRY (M5): global overtime for nursing management and allied health. Closed as Out of scope (explicit): a positive search found no such arrangement, so the correct action was to stop implying one exists rather than to keep hunting.

RESOLVED CARRY (M7): tamritz non-pensionability was asserted with no evidence for three cycles. Withdrawn rather than restated. Same treatment applied to the unsourced claim that the wage reduction spares the severance base.

STILL OPEN: doctors' own pensionable continuing-education gemulim (3rd cycle, no readable IMA source). Now recorded in domain-checklist.md as Out of scope (explicit) with a dated rationale so it stops recurring as a silent gap.

STILL OPEN: entry rank per education track on the nurse ladder.

METHOD LESSON (important, caught in this cycle): the research agent reported that government hospitals shortened the working week in a SINGLE step on 1.4.2024. The source says two steps, 1.12.2023 and 1.7.2024. Writing the reported version would have introduced a fresh error into the exact line the finding was about. A report is a place to look, never a fact to transcribe.

METHOD LESSON: the same agent reported the allied-health bands as image-only, echoing this skill's own prior institutional memory. They are page text now. A note that a table 'is an image' must be re-tested each cycle, because it permanently suppresses an answer the skill could otherwise give.

METHOD LESSON: a first fetch of the havraa page returned a 'public sector days table' identical to the private one. That was a model echo, not page content. Any table that arrives looking exactly like a table you already have should be re-read from the raw page before it is believed.

METHOD LESSON: the Judge said the 14.5.2025 doctors' havraa agreement did not exist because it was absent from the page it checked. The Expert found the dedicated Malam article, and the agreement is real, dated, and still running at 5% in 2026. A reviewer's negative is as much a lead as its positive: absence from ONE page is not absence.

METHOD LESSON: this cycle's own hedge on the severance base was the error, not the original text. The agreement expressly lists the one-off end-of-employment payment, bridging payments, the pension deposit and the mashkoret koveat as computed without the reduction. Withdrawing a claim is a change like any other and needs the source read before, not after.

NEW DEBT: hospital pharmacists and the academic dirug are named in the description but have no supplement set. Step 1 now routes them out explicitly rather than leaving a silent hole; either carry the mach'ar tosafot next cycle or cut them from the description (which drags in the description-eval gate).

NEW DEBT: whether the temporary wage reduction comes off before or after income tax is unstated, though the skill already notes the employer reports it in Tofes 126 under an income-tax field. Resolve next cycle; it moves every net estimate by the marginal rate on the reduced slice.

METHOD LESSON: adding a framework-agreement layer introduced an order-of-operations contradiction across three passages (intro, worked example, script docstring). When adding a multiplicative layer, state the rule once and re-read every passage that touches a base.
